name: Octree Construction for Point Clouds
definition: A hierarchical spatial data structure (octree) used to organize point cloud objects for rendering, where each node contains a list of points and recursively subdivides its bounding volume into eight octants until a leaf condition is met.
summary: Octree Construction for Point Clouds organizes data hierarchically to enable efficient CPU-based frustum culling and view-dependent sampling, distinguishing itself from flat voxel grids.
